statement: 0x80 gain signedness discrepancy: Linux IBEX haptic rumble struct declares left/right gain as u8, whereas SDL packed structure declares int8_t. For portable outputs use nonnegative raw gain 0x00..0x7f until host expectation is measured; preserve full raw byte for reverse direction. Kernel:367-375,793-814.

applicability.scope: Host-consumer expectations differ; this is a source comparison, not a conflict between measured device captures. Common behavior and reconciliation are stated in claim.
